description: Implementation of UE cell repository management, including handling of HARQ timeouts, adding and removing UEs, and related internal classes and methods.

classes.name: harq_manager_timeout_notifier
classes.description: Handles HARQ timeout notifications and updates metrics accordingly.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Processes pending HARQ timeouts for a given slot.

methods.name: deactivate
methods.description: Stops HARQ timers and deactivates the repository.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE to the repository with associated configurations and components.

methods.name: rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the repository based on its index.
